text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner! With the roar of 
the crowd thundering, they enter the 
straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gonna win...! I'll definitely! 
Win!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll finish this...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's come a third time! Almond Eye surges 
forward in a single breath!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No way...! I don't wanna give it up...! 
Not this place...! Not the Shuka Sho, of 
all things...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I absolutely will...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye takes the lead!! So strong! 
Almond Eye!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait up--

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here is the Umamusume making brand-new 
history!! Almond Eye crosses the finish 
line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
For this Umamusume, even the Triple Crown 
is merely a stepping stone!! It's Almond 
Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Here it is—!! The fifth Triple Tiara 
winner in history!! What a truly 
magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan is so insane...!! There's never 
been an Umamusume like her before!! I'm so 
deeply moved!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... gh... Ha... 
wheeze...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's far too bright...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(In the end, I couldn't win a single time 
all the way through... and Ai-san got the 
Triple Tiara—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Everything... got taken from me...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (What I was aiming for... is no longer—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Please let me thank you. Thank you so much 
for giving it your all against me today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was a race truly worthy of concluding 
the Triple Tiara. I'm so very glad I was 
able to defeat you here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the next race. I 
won't lose there, either!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (What the heck is that――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ain't that enough already...? You already 
won, damn it...! Isn't that plenty...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, even at this point, what is it 
you're still trying to beat...?!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Lala?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The next race, huh? I'll... look 
forward to it too, then.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even though she's right in front of me... 
Ai-san feels so far away...——)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to greet Lucky Lilac after her 
valiant effort in the Shuka Sho, but she 
was visibly exhausted both in body and 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. I'm sorry. I...—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: In the end... not even once...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've watched Lucky Lilac's hard work and 
perseverance closer than anyone else. I 
believed in her victory more than anyone 
in the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's so frustrating. That I 
couldn't lead her to victory. That I made 
her apologize to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable her rivals may 
be, Lucky Lilac will surely be able to win 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume who can endure and 
bloom. As her Trainer, I will keep 
believing in her and supporting her. I'm 
fully prepared to do so.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From here on out once more... I look 
forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Was I... able to give a proper smile just 
now...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're really running in the Japan 
Cup for your next race, then!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Aiming to become the strongest of the 
era, I plan to dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class members who have declared 
their entry are an exceptionally 
prestigious and formidable lineup. What 
are your thoughts on this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who my opponent is, I will win. 
That feeling hasn't changed from the very 
beginning."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I will win the Japan Cup against an 
amazing field and prove that I am the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘This announcement from Almond Eye 
quickly spread among race fans, pushing 
anticipation for the Japan Cup to its 
absolute peak—’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: What should we do about the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: I thought you might want a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sworn rival who handed me nothing but 
bitterness in the battles over the Triple 
Tiara. That is Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Japan Cup presents an early 
opportunity for revenge. However—
choice_data_list:
If you want to run, it'll require some 
tough conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac was far more exhausted 
from the recent 'Shuka Sho' than we had 
imagined."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering a grueling race like the Japan 
Cup, where so many powerhouses gather, 
means risks are unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, what matters most is how Lucky 
Lilac feels."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she wishes to run, then as her Trainer, 
it's my duty to give my absolute all to 
make that wish come true.
choice_data_list: Could you share your thoughts with me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I think I will pass on it. The Japan 
Cup, that is.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, Trainer, I still have 
lingering fatigue from the Shuka Sho, and 
on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
…………There will surely be more chances for 
me to get my revenge against Ai-san in the 
future, after all.
choice_data_list:
Okay, then let's pick a different goal 
race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As of right now, a prime candidate for our 
target race is the Nakayama Kinen—a 1800m 
turf GII held at Nakayama Racecourse next 
February.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a traditional race where Senior Class 
Umamusume often run to test their mettle 
with an eye on the big races from spring 
onwards.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The Nakayama Kinen, huh? ...Sounds good. 
By that time, everything should be fully 
back in top shape."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Nakayama Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided to kick off the 
Senior Class with the Nakayama Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (This is no good...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When I decided not to run in the Japan 
Cup today... Back then, I...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I felt relieved from the bottom of my 
heart... that I didn't have to race 
against Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is sooo lame~~~~............

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's stuck in my head... The feeling of 
constantly losing to Ai-san—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: …………I can't picture it at all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Seeing myself bloom—
